newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand says foreign banks offer credit lines.
newsitem.headline: Thailand says foreign banks offer credit lines.

text.p: Thai Finance Minister Thanong Bidaya said on Wednesday that Thailand had received numerous offers of credit lines from many major foreign commercial lenders.

"I can say that many world class banks have offered us emergency credit lines but we still have our own resources. Money is not the problem. The issue is for us to be united and not panic," he said, referring jitters among Thais about stability of Thai financial institutions.
He said many foreign investment bankers had queued up to see him but Thailand has more credit lines than it needs. He gave no further details.
